data_gap.note_zh: 本图层刻意保持空集合。控规控制线、文保与建设控制地带、道路红线、权属地块、轨道与蓝线均属锁定图层，公开场地包中无可引用的官方几何。缺口登记为 assumption A-CONTROLS-001；取得官方或已清权几何前，不得以推定线条冒充 official_constraint。
data_gap.note_en: This layer is intentionally empty. Regulatory control lines, heritage protection zones, road redlines, parcels, rail and blue lines are locked layers with no citable official geometry in the public site package. The gap is registered as assumption A-CONTROLS-001; inferred lines must not be presented as an official_constraint until official or cleared geometry is available.
